environment: Headless Edge on founder Windows laptop; new anonymous context per run; browser cache disabled; backend cold/warm state uncontrolled
limitations: Interaction event durations are a small lab sample, not field INP
CLS is sum over observation window, not whole-session field metric
Anonymous /fantasy/cards renders the sign-in recovery screen, not a logged-in collection
